entries.1cbaff24f4f912b1: The company is a cutting tool maker whose main product is carbide small-diameter end mills, and demand for its products moves in line with trends in precision and micro-machining fields such as semiconductors, electronic components and automobiles.
entries.1db27e3a2855c370: The strategy is to focus on carbide small-diameter end mills, continuously launch new products through agile development, and expand the range of high value-added products.

entries.3d317be52f4bbc0c: The business model manufactures carbide small-diameter end mills at its own plant and sells them through agents and domestic and overseas sales subsidiaries to manufacturing customers that use machine tools.
entries.57665e099ec2a736: Its brand statement is 'Creating beyond Making', and its basic management policy is to create high value-added products that meet the needs of customers and society and to open up the dreams and possibilities of manufacturing. In production technology development, its basic policy is to upgrade existing technology through responding to next-generation processing technologies, and it plans to improve the functions of its in-house developed tool grinders and expand the automatic measurement range using image processing technology.
